Fixed the replica crash in `src/acl.c`.

The `ACL LOAD` client-update loop dereferenced `c->user->name` unconditionally, but on a replica the primary replication link (`server.primary`) deliberately has `c->user == NULL` (superuser). Skipping user-less clients prevents the crash while leaving the replication link unaffected.
